description: The structured hypothesis record from Del's LABORATORY spec (section 6, 'The hypothesis system'). A hypothesis without a disproof condition cannot be filed: disproof_condition is a required field, so the record itself refuses it. evidence_level is the claim's rung on the evidence ladder (LABORATORY section 7); it is a field on the record, not prose, and it may only be raised by the independent verifier's promotion, never by author edit. New hypotheses file at level 0. No automated path in this system raises a record above level 3; levels 4 to 6 require physical experiments and independent replication by qualified humans and exist in the vocabulary only so externally established knowledge can be recorded by a human, on the record.

alternative_explanation.description: The strongest competing explanation for the same observation, including model or method limitations.

disproof_condition.description: MANDATORY. What evidence would disprove this hypothesis: independent calculations showing no reproducible difference, or an adequately controlled experiment contradicting the prediction. A record without this field is not a hypothesis and must be refused at filing.

evidence_level.description: Evidence ladder level (LABORATORY section 7): 0 idea, 1 evidence supported, 2 computationally tested, 3 independently reproduced, 4 experimentally validated, 5 independently replicated, 6 established application. Set at filing to 0; raised only by the independent verifier after re-execution, and never above 3 by any automated path in this system.

filed_by.description: Nick of the agent that filed the record (normally hypothesis-generator).

id.description: Unique hypothesis identifier in this lab, for example H001.

measurable_prediction.description: The measurable change that should occur under defined conditions if the explanation holds.

sources.description: Identifiers of retrieved original sources supporting the underlying assumptions (level 1 evidence). A search result is a lead, never a source.

status.description: Working status of the hypothesis. Disproved and vetoed hypotheses are kept on the record permanently; deletion is falsification.

title: Science Lab hypothesis record
